paragraphs: I have a dog. His name is Max. Max is small and brown.
Max can run. Max can jump. I have a ball. I play with Max. Max runs to the ball.
Max is happy. I am happy, too. I love Max.
title: My Dog Max

paragraphs: This is my mom. I love my mom. My mom is nice.
My mom can cook. I can help. We eat cake. The cake is good.
I sing a song. My mom is happy. I am happy, too.
title: My Mom and I

paragraphs: Dino is a small dinosaur. He lives with his mom in a green valley. One day, Dino sees a dark cave. "I am scared," he says. But Dino is brave. He walks to the cave.
"Roar!" A big sound comes from the cave. "Was that a roar?" Dino asks. He runs back to his mom. "Mom, a monster is in the cave!" Mom smiles. "Let's look together."
In the cave, they see a small bird. The bird is hurt. It cannot fly. Dino gives the bird some water. He shares his food with the bird. The bird sings a happy song.
"You are brave," says Mom. "And you love to share." Dino is not scared now. He has a new friend.

quiz.evidenceSentence: One day, Dino sees a dark cave.
quiz.question: Why is Dino scared at first?

quiz.evidenceSentence: In the cave, they see a small bird.
quiz.question: What is in the cave?

title: Dino and the Dark Cave

paragraphs: Fifi is a little fox. She lives on a farm near a river. Fifi is kind. She loves to help.
One day, Fifi sees a small sheep. The sheep is sad. The sheep says, "I cannot find my mom." "Do not cry," says Fifi. "I can help you."
Fifi and the sheep walk in the forest. They climb a small hill. They see the sheep's mom near the river. "Mom!" the sheep calls.
The sheep is happy now. She shares her apples with Fifi. "Thank you, kind Fifi," she says. Fifi smiles. She has a new friend.

quiz.evidenceSentence: They see the sheep's mom near the river.
quiz.question: Where do they find the sheep's mom?

title: The Kind Fox
